She needs someone capable to thin their numbers before they claim more victims. The wolves have been spotted near the old hollow oak where the forest grows thickest.
hook: The wolves grow bolder by the day. Their howls echo through the woods, and I've found tracks too close to the village for comfort. Thin their numbers, and the road will be safe again. I'll know when the deed is done.

He suspects Lilith Darkmoor, a Tiefling spy associated with the Rustwater Corsairs, who was seen lurking near the monastery grounds days before the theft. The ring bears the seal of the monastery's founding abbot and holds great sentimental value. Aldric wants it retrieved quietly without bloodshed.
hook: That ring has blessed every prior of this monastery for three centuries. Lilith Darkmoor thinks she can waltz in and steal our history? I'd wager she's still at Sunken Harbor, probably showing it off to her Corsair friends. Bring it back to me, and do try to avoid unnecessary violence.

Pippin Shortwick, a Halfling merchant, will be transporting a shipment of Silver Dust and rare alchemical components. Rumors suggest that Syndicate Cutthroats have been asking questions about this particular shipment. The Iron Circle wants an extra blade watching over Pippin until the goods reach their destination safely.
hook: Pippin Shortwick's carrying a fortune in Silver Dust through territory the Whisperwind Syndicate likes to prowl. We've got our own patrols, but an extra pair of eyes on the Halfling himself wouldn't hurt. Keep him breathing and the cargo intact, and you'll be paid in honest steel.

description: Bram Ironfoot has received intelligence that Lysandra Vane, a Half-Elf spy for the Whisperwind Syndicate, is coordinating a series of thefts targeting Iron Circle supply lines. She operates from a safehouse in the Gilded Bazaar. While killing her might cause too much political fallout, Bram wants her operation disrupted and her confidence shaken. Rough her up enough to send a message that the Iron Circle is watching.
hook: Vane thinks she's untouchable, hiding behind the Syndicate's web of informants. I need someone to remind her that Ironhold Keep has a long memory and a longer reach. Find her in the Bazaar and make sure she limps for a week. That should cool her ambitions for a while.

Belladonna wants that vial for her own poison-crafting work. The vial is kept in Nissa's temporary workshop at the cavern entrance while she conducts mining surveys. A quiet acquisition would benefit the Syndicate's alchemical division immensely.
hook: Nissa Fizzlebang doesn't deserve a vial of that quality. She'll waste it on some minor potion for the Consortium's profit margins. I could create something truly exquisite with it. She's working out of Glimmerstone Caverns currently. Relieve her of the vial and bring it to me. Quietly.

Seraphina Goldleaf will want a full report when the deed is done.
hook: Grimshaw's hands are stained with our rangers' blood. He's out in the Ashen Scar digging up trouble for Stone. The Order has sanctioned his removal from this world. Find him, end him, and report to Seraphina Goldleaf at Verdant Hollow. She'll want to know every detail.

These creatures have been attacking workers and disrupting ore shipments. Three of the beasts have been spotted in the upper chambers. Clearing them out would allow work to resume at full capacity.
hook: Blasted Cave Stalkers have my workers spooked. Can't get a full day's labor out of anyone when they're watching the shadows for teeth and claws. There's three of them in the upper caverns. Deal with them and let me know when it's safe to send the crews back in.

hook: That pelt was going to be a masterwork jerkin for a noble in Ironhold Keep! Zephyr's the only stranger I saw that night. Find that thieving Half-Elf, get my pelt back, and I'll make you something fine from my remaining stock.

Quill Kettlewhistle, a Gnome scribe from the Gilded Consortium, is currently at the monastery copying ancient texts for both organizations. The Order fears the cultists may try to steal the manuscripts or harm the scribe. They want someone to ensure Quill completes his work safely.
hook: Quill Kettlewhistle is copying texts that could help us understand the corruption spreading in the Ashen Scar. Cultists have been spotted nearby, and we can't risk them interrupting his work or worse. Guard him until the copying is complete. Brother Aldric will provide what you need.

Stone wants him taught a painful lesson before he can share more sensitive intelligence. Blackwater has been spotted drinking at a tavern in Eldrin Crossing, apparently feeling safe so far from the harbor.
hook: Blackwater's got a loose tongue and it's costing me ships. He's holed up in Eldrin Crossing thinking distance makes him safe. Break a few of his bones for me. Make sure he understands that the Corsairs have a long reach and a longer memory.

description: Lysandra Vane wants Fenthwick Cobblepot's merchant ledger. The ledger contains records of all Gilded Consortium trade routes and client information, which the Syndicate could use for targeted acquisitions. The ledger is disguised as a bundle of Unsent Letters in Fenthwick's office in Eldrin Crossing. Vane doesn't care how you get it, but emphasizes that Fenthwick himself is worth more alive as a future source.
hook: Cobblepot keeps his real ledger disguised as personal correspondence. Clever, but not clever enough. Get into his office in Eldrin Crossing and bring me those Unsent Letters. Deal with anyone who gets in your way—just leave Cobblepot breathing. Dead merchants don't generate future opportunities.

description: Orion Falkenrath has been tracking a cell of Cultist Acolytes operating from Ravenloft Cemetery. His divinations reveal they're led by an Acolyte who has been receiving instructions from someone in Sunken Harbor—likely Nyx or Lilith Darkmoor. The cell has been desecrating graves to fuel some dark ritual. Orion wants the leader eliminated and evidence of their activities brought back for study.
hook: These cultists are puppets, but their leader is a true believer who's been given real power. I've tracked them to Ravenloft Cemetery. End their leader—the one with the strange idol around their neck—and bring me anything that might tell us who's pulling their strings. The corruption spreads while we hesitate.

She needs the spiders cleared before she can harvest the nightshade petals needed for upcoming medicinal preparations. There are at least four of the creatures nesting in the garden's old oak tree.
hook: My nightshade will rot if I can't get to it, and people will suffer without their medicine. Giant Spiders have claimed my garden as their territory. Kill them and let me know when it's safe to work again.

The idol has markings that match those found in the Ashen Scar. Hemlock believes Vex is still in the cemetery somewhere, hiding until she can safely transport the idol to the Gilded Bazaar.
hook: That idol wasn't meant for profane hands. Vex took it while I was tending to the eastern graves. She's still in the cemetery—I'd sense if it had left. Find her, reclaim what was stolen, and return it. Quietly, if possible. The dead prefer discretion.

description: Corporal Hayes is overseeing the reinforcement of Ironhold Keep's eastern wall, which has been weakened by recent storms and a minor rockslide. The Iron Circle has received reports that Rustwater Corsair scouts have been seen in the area, possibly looking for vulnerabilities to exploit. They want someone to watch Hayes' back while he directs the repairs, ensuring no Corsair assassins get close.
hook: Hayes is a good soldier, but he's focused on the stonework, not on who might be watching from the treeline. The Corsairs would love to pick off one of our corporals during a vulnerable moment. Keep him alive until that wall is secure.

Marrow has been ambushing Iron Circle prospectors and stealing their ore shipments. Garruk wants Marrow taught a lesson in Iron Circle justice—beaten within an inch of his life as a warning to other would-be thieves.
hook: Marrow's an embarrassment to Orcs everywhere—a coward who attacks unarmed miners. I'd kill him myself, but orders are to send a message, not a corpse. Find him in the Ashen Scar and leave him breathing, but only just. Let him crawl back to whatever hole he came from.

She wants one of Belladonna's vials acquired so she can analyze its composition. The vials are kept in Belladonna's private workshop in the Gilded Bazaar.
hook: Belladonna's poisons have a unique signature—I've seen their effects. If I can study one of her vials, I might unlock the secret to counteracting them entirely. She keeps her best work in her Bazaar workshop. Bring me one and I'll share what I learn.

Worse, she's been using her knowledge of Ironhold's defenses to help the Corsairs plan raids. Bram Ironfoot has declared her a traitor and issued a death warrant. Intelligence places her in Sunken Harbor, working directly under Captain Valerius Stone's protection. Bram wants proof of the deed.
hook: Stonehearth ate our bread and learned our secrets, then sold them to the Corsairs. She's a traitor to her kin and her keep. The sentence is death. Find her in Sunken Harbor and carry it out. Bring me something to prove it's done—and be ready for Stone's retaliation.

Yorick the Gravedigger has been unable to rebury them properly and needs help putting the spirits back to rest. Three of the creatures have been sighted wandering the cemetery grounds at night.
hook: The dead should stay dead. That's the natural order. But something's got these old soldiers riled up and walking again. I can't dig fast enough to keep up. Put them down proper, and I'll make sure you're compensated for the grim work.

Sable, a Half-Elf who works for the Syndicate but has been acting strangely, stole the manuscript—possibly to sell to a rival faction. Sable has been seen in Eldrin Crossing meeting with unknown contacts.
hook: That manuscript is more than just a song. Sable stole it, and I need it back before she sells the information inside. She's been seen in Eldrin Crossing. Get my work back and bring it to me. And try not to damage it—some of the rhymes took weeks to perfect.

The Order has received intelligence that the Rustwater Corsairs may attempt to disrupt the ritual, possibly sending assassins. She must be protected until the ritual is complete.
hook: Seraphina's ritual will renew the wards that have protected Verdant Hollow for generations. She cannot defend herself while channeling. If the Corsairs want to strike at our heart, now is when they'd try. Guard her until the ritual's light fades. The Order will not forget this service.

Belladonna Shade has been authorized to administer punishment. Zephyr has fled to the Whispering Woods, hoping to lie low until the heat dies down. Belladonna wants Zephyr found and beaten severely—alive, but regretting every decision that led to this moment.
hook: Zephyr thought she could play all sides and walk away clean. She's hiding in the Whispering Woods. Find her and remind her why people fear the Syndicate. Leave her breathing—we want her to spread the word about what happens to those who betray us.

hook: Darkmoor wears a holy symbol and speaks prayers while she pours poison down good soldiers' throats. The ancestors cry out for justice. Find her in Sunken Harbor and deliver the judgment she's earned. The Corsairs will howl, but Ironhold does not let murderers walk free.

description: Elowen Mistweaver has been studying the elemental disturbances in the Ashen Scar. Several Ember Elementals have manifested near an ancient ruin she needs to access for her research. The elementals are aggressive and territorial, making approach impossible. She needs them dispersed—not permanently destroyed, as that might destabilize the area's magic, but damaged enough to retreat and reform elsewhere.
hook: Ember Elementals guard the ruin I need to study. I can't approach while they're active. They're elemental beings—you can't truly kill them, but you can damage their forms enough to force them back to their plane. Do that, and let me know when the path is clear.

The ore was specially selected for forging ceremonial weapons for the Iron Circle's annual ceremony. Petra needs that specific ore back—it has unique properties she can't replicate with standard supplies.
hook: That ore was selected by my own hands for the Founders' Ceremony. Marrow's crew took it, probably planning to sell it to some two-copper smith. I need it back. Find Marrow, get my ore, and don't worry about being gentle with anyone who gets in your way.

The Gilded Consortium has heard reports of increased Shadowmire Wolf activity and possible bandit ambushes along the forest path. They want someone to escort Fenthwick safely to his destination and ensure both he and the contract arrive intact.
hook: Cobblepot's carrying papers that could make or break a major Consortium deal. The woods are dangerous, and he's no fighter. Get him to Verdant Hollow safely, and the Consortium will remember your reliability.

description: Anya Swift's younger brother was beaten badly by Tamsin Fleetwood during a confrontation at the harbor. The fight was over a hunting territory dispute, but Fleetwood went too far, leaving the boy with broken ribs. Anya wants payback—not death, but enough damage that Fleetwood thinks twice before raising a hand to a hunter again. Fleetwood works the docks at Sunken Harbor most evenings.
hook: My brother's still coughing blood because Fleetwood couldn't control her temper. I'm not asking you to kill her—just make sure she remembers what it feels like to be on the receiving end. She'll be at the harbor docks after sunset.

Whisper keeps detailed notes about Syndicate operations disguised as Unsent Letters in her quarters at the Gilded Bazaar. Blackwater wants those notes—not to harm the Syndicate, but to ensure his own position is protected if Whisper ever moves against him. He needs the acquisition to be completely deniable.
hook: Whisper's got dirt on everyone in the Syndicate, including me. I need to know what she knows about my operations. She keeps her notes in her Bazaar quarters. Get them for me, and make sure no one knows who took them. This stays between us.

description: Quill Kettlewhistle's apprentice, a young Gnome named Pip, was murdered while delivering manuscripts to Ravenloft Cemetery. The killer was Vex Holloway, who took the manuscripts and left Pip's body in an open grave. The manuscripts contained nothing of value—Vex killed him simply because he saw something he shouldn't have. Quill wants justice for his apprentice. Vex is still operating from the cemetery, using it as a base for Syndicate operations.
hook: Pip was sixteen. He had a talent for illumination that would have made him famous one day. Vex killed him for nothing—just being in the wrong place. I want her dead. Find her in the cemetery and end her. I'll pay whatever it takes.

description: Tamsin Fleetwood is having trouble with her own people. A group of Corsair Deckhands has been harassing her crew, stealing from her catches, and generally making her operation at the harbor difficult. They're low-level thugs who think her success makes her a target. She wants them roughed up and warned off—nothing fatal, as killing fellow Corsairs would bring unwanted attention from Captain Stone.
hook: These deckhands think because I'm not swinging a sword every day, I'm soft. They've been taking my fish and threatening my crew. Teach them some respect, but don't kill anyone. Stone gets touchy about dead Corsairs, even the worthless ones.

description: The Warden, a Lizardfolk scholar studying the ancient ruins beneath Glimmerstone Caverns, had a Strange Idol stolen from his collection. The idol is key to understanding the connection between the caverns and the corruption in the Ashen Scar. He tracked the thief to Marrow's camp in the Ashen Scar. Marrow doesn't understand the idol's significance and probably intends to sell it as a curiosity.
hook: The idol was taken by a creature called Marrow. He does not understand what he holds. The idol speaks of the old ways, before the corruption came. Retrieve it for me, and I will share knowledge of the stars that few have ever seen.

description: Mira Thorne is leading a foraging expedition into the deeper parts of the Whispering Woods to harvest rare nightshade before the first frost. The area she needs to access is known for Forest Lurker activity and the occasional Corrupted Dryad. The Order wants someone to protect her while she works—she's too valuable as their primary apothecary to risk losing. Stitches Malone from the Gilded Consortium will also be present to observe her techniques.
hook: Mira's work saves lives—including, perhaps, yours one day. She needs to harvest in dangerous territory, and we need her to come back. Protect her while she works. Stitches Malone will be there too, learning from her. Keep them both breathing.

description: Drogan Shieldbiter lent Torvin Coalbeard a significant sum of gold to finance a mining expedition in Glimmerstone Caverns. The expedition was successful, but Torvin has been making excuses about repayment for months. Drogan wants the debt collected with interest—in the form of bruises. He's not asking for Torvin's death, just a persuasive reminder that debts to the Iron Circle come due.
hook: Torvin's been drinking my ale and spending my gold for months, always with another excuse about why he can't pay. I want you to explain to him, with your fists, that Ironhold doesn't forget debts. He's in the Caverns, counting his silver. Remind him who he owes.

These routes could also be used to move Order supplies without detection. He wants one of these fragments acquired. Marlowe Reed, a Halfling thief working for the Corsairs, is known to carry a fragment on his person at all times. Kaelen doesn't care how you get it.
hook: The Corsairs use Star Map Fragments to navigate waters others fear. If we had one, we could move supplies along the coast without being seen. Marlowe Reed carries one. Get it for me, by whatever means necessary. The Order will be in your debt.

description: Corporal Hayes has been feeding the Iron Circle information about Whisperwind Syndicate operations for years. He's responsible for the arrest and execution of at least four Syndicate agents. The Syndicate has finally tracked his movements and knows when he'll be alone on the eastern wall of Ironhold Keep, overseeing repairs. They want him eliminated as a message that no one is beyond their reach. Lysandra Vane will receive your report.
hook: Hayes has cost us agents and operations for too long. We know his schedule, we know his blind spots. Get into Ironhold Keep, end him, and get out. Report to Vane at the Bazaar when it's done. The Syndicate rewards those who remove our enemies.

Three of the creatures have been sighted regularly at night.
hook: I can't do my work with those Bone Wraiths floating about. They've claimed the northern section as their territory. Drive them off so I can fix what the grave robbers broke. Silver works best against them, if you have any.

Osric wants the money recovered—or at least as much as can be salvaged.
hook: Five hundred crowns, stolen by a Halfling with sticky fingers. Jasper Knackles is spending my money in the Bazaar's gambling halls. Get it back. I don't care how. Just bring me what you can recover.

The forge must remain lit and the work uninterrupted for three days to properly temper the steel. The Iron Circle has received threats that someone—likely Syndicate agents—may attempt to sabotage the work. They want someone to guard Drogan while he completes the crucial phase of the forging.
hook: Drogan's forge must burn uninterrupted for three days. If someone puts it out or distracts him at the wrong moment, months of work are ruined. Watch his back. The Syndicate would love to embarrass us at the ceremony.

He doesn't want him killed—dead merchants can't learn lessons—but badly beaten, somewhere public enough that others will hear about it.
hook: Cartwright thinks he can humiliate me and face no consequences. He needs to learn that every word has a price. Find him in Eldrin Crossing and teach him that lesson with your fists. Make sure there are witnesses.

The problem is that Gloomspore Shamblers are dangerous and tend to cluster around the very nightshade patches Malone needs. He wants someone to harvest the petals after dealing with any Shamblers in the area.
hook: Regular nightshade won't work for what I'm treating. I need petals that have been touched by Gloomspore—it changes the alkaloid structure. The Shamblers guard their territory fiercely. Clear them out, harvest the nightshade near their lair, and bring it to me.

description: Sable didn't just steal Lyra's manuscript—she sold the coded information to a rival merchant house, resulting in the deaths of two Syndicate operatives whose identities were revealed. The Syndicate has authorized her elimination. Lyra wants the satisfaction of knowing Sable paid for the blood on her hands. Sable has been hiding in Eldrin Crossing, protected by a merchant who doesn't realize what she's done.
hook: Two of our people are dead because Sable sold their names. The Syndicate wants her gone, and I want to be the one who made it happen. Find her in Eldrin Crossing, end her, and tell me it's done. I'll compose a ballad about it.

He needs them cleared out so the local wildlife will return and his traps can function again.
hook: Forest Lurkers are supposed to be solitary, but these three are acting like a pack. They've ruined a week's worth of trapping. Clear them out of my territory and let me know when it's safe to reset my lines.

He needs it back before someone uses it to forge documents or infiltrate Ironhold.
hook: The ring itself is just metal and memory, but in the wrong hands, it could be used to impersonate an Iron Circle priest. Nyx took it in Sunken Harbor. I need it back, quietly. The Circle doesn't need to know I was careless enough to lose it.

hook: Glint's got a nose for silver like no one else. The deep caverns are dangerous, but the payoff could set the Consortium up for years. Keep him alive down there, and there'll be a bonus in it for you when he strikes the motherlode.

hook: Boulder thinks he can operate in my territory without paying tribute. He's poaching my crew and keeping all the profits. Find him in the Ashen Scar and remind him who runs the Corsairs. Leave him breathing—I want him to tell others what happens to those who forget their place.

Marlowe Reed killed Theron during a robbery gone wrong in Sunken Harbor. Elara has waited years for the right moment to take her revenge. She's learned that Reed has risen in the Corsair ranks and now operates openly at the harbor. She wants him dead, and she wants to know it's done.
hook: I've waited seven years for this. Reed killed the only person I ever truly trusted. The Corsairs protected him, but now I have the resources and I have you. Find him in Sunken Harbor. Kill him. Come back and tell me he's gone from this world.
